name.zh: 瑞金—于都

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 于都—汝城—城口—宜章（突破第二、三道封锁线）
name.en: Yudu–Rucheng–Chengkou–Yizhang (breaking the second and third blockade lines)

description.zh: 红军经汝城、城口间突破第二道封锁线，再经宜章突破第三道封锁线。
description.en: The Red Army broke the second blockade line between Rucheng and Chengkou, then the third at Yizhang.

name.zh: 宜章—道县—文市—界首（突破第四道封锁线）

description.zh: 中央红军从宜章西进，经道县、文市进抵湘江东岸，11 月 27 日抢占界首等渡口，11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日渡江。
description.en: The Central Red Army advanced west from Yizhang through Daoxian and Wenshi to the east bank of the Xiang River, seized Jieshou and other ferries on 27 November, and crossed on 30 November–1 December.

name.zh: 湘江渡口群与阻击阵地（屏山—脚山铺—大坪—凤凰嘴—界首）
name.en: Xiang River ferries and blocking positions (Pingshan–Jiaoshanpu–Daping–Fenghuangzui–Jieshou)

description.zh: 红一军团等部控制屏山至界首约 30 公里的湘江渡口，并在脚山铺、新圩、光华铺等地阻击敌军，掩护中央纵队渡江。
description.en: The First Army Corps and other units controlled the Xiang River ferries along about 30 km from Pingshan to Jieshou and blocked the enemy at Jiaoshanpu, Xinxu, and Guanghuapu to cover the crossing of the central column.

name.zh: 后卫阻击（文市—水车—新圩—楠木山）

description.zh: 红五军团第三十四师与红三军团第六师第十八团在文市、水车、新圩、楠木山一线节节阻击，掩护中央纵队和后续部队渡过湘江。
description.en: The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps and the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, fought delaying actions along Wenshi, Shuiche, Xinxu, and Nanmushan to cover the crossing of the central column and follow-up units.

name.zh: 界首—越城岭—龙胜—通道

description.zh: 湘江战役后，中央红军经越城岭、龙胜进入湖南通道。
description.en: After the Xiang River battle, the Central Red Army moved through the Yuecheng Ridge and Longsheng into Tongdao, Hunan.

name.zh: 红三十四师突围（文塘—灌阳—道县石马神）

description.zh: 红三十四师余部由全州安和文塘突围，经灌阳、道县四马桥转战，师长陈树湘于 12 月 18 日在蚣坝镇石马神村牺牲。
description.en: Survivors of the Thirty-Fourth Division broke out from Wentang in Anhe, Quanzhou, and moved through Guanyang and Simaqiao in Daoxian; commander Chen Shuxiang died at Shimashen Village, Gongba, on 18 December.

name.zh: 通道—黎平

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 黎平—猴场

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 猴场—遵义

description.zh: 红军由猴场北上，经江界河渡口突破乌江，进抵遵义。
description.en: The Red Army moved north from Houchang, crossed the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, and advanced to Zunyi.

name.zh: 遵义—土城（经桐梓、习水）

description.zh: 中央红军从遵义经桐梓、习水向土城开进，1 月 28 日在青杠坡与川军激战，次日一渡赤水。
description.en: The Central Red Army advanced from Zunyi through Tongzi and Xishui toward Tucheng, fought Sichuan troops at Qinggangpo on 28 January, and crossed the Chishui River the next day.

name.zh: 土城—古蔺—扎西（一渡后西进）

description.zh: 一渡赤水后，红军经古蔺、叙永西进云南扎西集结。
description.en: After the first crossing, the Red Army moved west through Gulin and Xuyong to assemble at Zhaxi in Yunnan.

name.zh: 扎西—太平渡/二郎滩（二渡）

description.zh: 二渡回师黔北，红军从太平渡、九溪口、老鸹沱、二郎滩、淋滩等渡口东渡赤水河。
description.en: On the second crossing the Red Army returned to northern Guizhou, crossing the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, Laoguatuo, Erlangtan, and Lintan.

name.zh: 二郎滩—桐梓—娄山关—遵义

description.zh: 二渡后红军经桐梓攻占娄山关，再占遵义。
description.en: After the second crossing, the Red Army advanced through Tongzi, captured Loushan Pass, and retook Zunyi.

name.zh: 遵义城南防御线（红花岗—老鸦山）

description.zh: 红三军团在遵义城南红花岗、老鸦山一线构筑防御，红一军团主力由水师坝向忠庄铺侧击。
description.en: The Third Army Corps defended the Honghuagang–Laoyashan line south of Zunyi while the main force of the First Army Corps struck toward Zhongzhuangpu from Shuishiba.

name.zh: 遵义—茅台（三渡）

description.zh: 三渡前红军由遵义西进茅台，3 月 16 日至 17 日在茅台中渡口、下渡口、银滩西渡赤水河。
description.en: Before the third crossing, the Red Army moved west from Zunyi to Maotai and crossed the Chishui River westward at Maotai’s middle ferry, lower ferry, and Yintan on 16–17 March.

name.zh: 茅台—古蔺—二郎滩/太平渡（四渡）

description.zh: 三渡后红军佯动古蔺，3 月 21 日至 22 日由二郎滩、太平渡、九溪口、淋滩东渡赤水河。
description.en: After the third crossing, the Red Army feinted toward Gulin and crossed the Chishui River eastward at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, and Lintan on 21–22 March.

name.zh: 太平渡—乌江—贵阳—惠水—长顺—紫云

description.zh: 红军由太平渡南渡乌江、佯攻贵阳，随后经惠水、长顺西进，4 月 15 日至 16 日进至紫云。4 月 13 日在长顺分左右两路纵队抢渡北盘江：右路（红三军团、红五军团）由镇宁经坝草、白层渡江，左路（红一军团、军委纵队）由紫云经者坪渡江，另见「镇宁—坝草—白层—贞丰」「紫云—册亨—安龙—兴仁」两段。路线为示意，各路纵队分进路线未再细分。
description.en: The Red Army crossed the Wu River south of Taipingdu and feinted toward Guiyang, then moved west through Huishui and Changshun, reaching Ziyun on 15–16 April. On 13 April the main force split at Changshun into two columns to cross the Beipan: the right column (Third and Fifth Army Corps) via Zhenning, Bacao and Baiceng, and the left column (First Army Corps and the Military Commission column) via Zheyang from Ziyun, drawn as the “Zhenning–Bacao–Baiceng–Zhenfeng” and “Ziyun–Ceheng–Anlong–Xingren” segments. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 龙街渡佯渡（元谋—龙街渡）

description.zh: 红一军团由元谋进至龙街渡，架桥佯渡牵制敌军，后顺江而下转赴皎平渡。
description.en: The First Army Corps moved from Yuanmou to Longjie Ferry, feinted a bridge crossing to pin the enemy, then moved downstream to Jiaopingdu.

name.zh: 沾益—寻甸—禄劝—马鹿塘—洪门渡（右纵队·红三军团）
name.en: Zhanyi–Xundian–Luquan–Malutang–Hongmen Ferry (right column, Third Army Corps)

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 27 日红三军团由曲靖北上攻占沾益，29 日攻克寻甸。鲁口哨渡江令规定三军团为右纵队奔洪门渡：经禄劝、马鹿塘北进，5 月 3 日先头到达洪门渡，架设浮桥被冲毁，仅红十三团由一只木船渡过，5 月 5 日主力奉命转赴皎平渡。路线为示意，寻甸至禄劝一段与中央纵队并行。
description.en: On 27 April 1935 the Third Army Corps moved north from Qujing to take Zhanyi and on 29 April took Xundian. The Lukoushao order made it the right column, heading for Hongmen Ferry: it moved north via Luquan and Malutang, reached Hongmen on 3 May, failed to hold a pontoon bridge, got only the 13th Regiment across in a single boat, and on 5 May was ordered to turn to Jiaopingdu. The line is schematic; the Xundian–Luquan leg runs parallel to the central column.

name.zh: 会泽—拖布卡—树桔渡—华弹—宁南—普格—礼州（红九军团归建）
name.en: Huize–Tuobuka–Shuju Ferry–Huatan–Ningnan–Puge–Lizhou (Ninth Army Corps rejoins the main force)

description.zh: 红九军团由会泽经拖布卡进至树桔渡，打捞沉船、夺取盐船，5 月 6 日至 7 日全军团渡过金沙江。过江后沿金沙江北进，经冬瓜坪、塘房、红果，5 月 8 日至 15 日在洼乌（今宁南华弹）阻敌，掩护中央及主力红军渡江，随后经宁南、普格北上，5 月 21 日在西昌礼州与主力会合。路线为示意，沿江逐日行程未全部画出，华弹、宁南、普格、礼州为示意点。
description.en: The Ninth Army Corps moved from Huize via Tuobuka to Shuju Ferry, raised a sunken boat and seized salt boats, and crossed the Jinsha River with the whole corps on 6–7 May. It then moved north along the river through Dongguaping, Tangfang and Hongguo, fought a blocking action at Wawu (present-day Huatan, Ningnan) from 8 to 15 May to cover the crossing of the Centre and the main force, went north via Ningnan and Puge, and rejoined the main force at Lizhou, Xichang, on 21 May. The line is schematic: the daily marches along the river are not fully drawn, and Huatan, Ningnan, Puge and Lizhou are representative points.

name.zh: 皎平渡—通安—会理

description.zh: 红军由皎平渡过江后经通安北上，进抵会理；会理会议在城北铁厂村召开。
description.en: After crossing at Jiaopingdu, the Red Army advanced via Tongan to Huili; the Huili meeting was held at Tiechang Village north of the city.

name.zh: 会理—冕宁—彝海—安顺场（强渡大渡河）

description.zh: 红军由会理北上，经西昌、礼州、泸沽、冕宁、大桥、拖乌、彝海进入安顺场，准备强渡大渡河。
description.en: The Red Army moved north from Huili through Xichang, Lizhou, Lugu, Mianning, Daqiao, Tuowu, and Yihai to Anshunchang to force the Dadu River.

name.zh: 大树堡佯动（泸沽—越西—海棠—大树堡）

description.zh: 红一军团第二师第五团等由泸沽经越西、海棠进至大树堡，佯攻富林，牵制川军，掩护主力从安顺场渡河。
description.en: The Fifth Regiment of the Second Division advanced from Lugu through Yuexi and Haitang to Dashubao, feinting toward Fulin to pin Sichuan troops while the main force crossed at Anshunchang.

name.zh: 安顺场—得妥—兴隆—泸定（飞夺泸定桥）

description.zh: 红军沿大渡河西岸北上，经得妥、加郡、兴隆、冷碛进抵泸定桥；毛泽东等经磨西一线跟进。
description.en: The Red Army moved north along the west bank of the Dadu River through Detuo, Jiajun, Xinglong, and Lengqi to Luding Bridge; Mao Zedong and others followed via Moxi.

name.zh: 懋功—两河口—梦笔山—卓克基—长板山—芦花—昌德山—达古山—毛儿盖

description.zh: 中央红军由懋功北上，经两河口、梦笔山、卓克基、长板山（雅克夏）、芦花、昌德山、达古山，进抵毛儿盖。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The Central Red Army moved north from Maogong through Lianghekou, Mengbi Mountain, Zhuokeji, Changban Mountain (Yakexia), Luhua, Changde Mountain, and Dagu Mountain to Maoergai. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 毛儿盖—包座—班佑—巴西（过草地）

description.zh: 红军由毛儿盖过草地，经包座、班佑进抵巴西；包座战役保障了右路军北上通道。
description.en: The Red Army crossed the grasslands from Maoergai through Baozuo and Banyou to Baxi; the Baozuo battle secured the right column’s route north.

name.zh: 巴西—俄界—腊子口

description.zh: 中央率红一、红三军由巴西连夜北上，经俄界会议后继续向腊子口前进。
description.en: The central leadership led the First and Third Army Corps north from Baxi, held the Ejie meeting, and continued toward Lazikou.

name.zh: 腊子口—哈达铺

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 哈达铺—吴起镇

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 吴起—直罗镇

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 直罗镇—延川（东征准备）

description.zh: 直罗镇战役后，红一方面军主力东移延川、延长一带休整，并准备东渡黄河。路线为示意。
description.en: After the Zhiluozhen battle the main force of the First Front Army moved east to the Yanchuan–Yanchang area to rest and prepare to cross the Yellow River eastward. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 会宁—将台堡

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。

name.zh: 乌江渡口群（茶山关—桃子台—楠木渡—孙家渡—江界河—袁家渡—回龙场）

description.zh: 中央红军在茶山关、桃子台、楠木渡、孙家渡、江界河、袁家渡、回龙场等渡口偷渡或强渡乌江，以竹筏、浮桥突破黔军侯之担部防线。路线为示意，串联各渡口位置。
description.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Wu River by stealth or assault at Chashanguan, Taozitai, Nanmudu, Sunjiadu, Jiangjiehe, Yuanjiadu, and Huilongchang, using bamboo rafts and pontoon bridges to break Hou Zhidan’s defense line. The route is schematic and links the ferry sites.

name.zh: 长干山—枫香坝—老木孔—瓢儿井—毕节—盘县—宣威—会泽（红九军团单独行动）

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 21 日至 22 日，红九军团随中央红军主力由太平渡、二郎滩一带四渡赤水。3 月 24 日起（一说 27 日、30 日），九军团奉命伪装红军主力，在长干山、枫香坝（今遵义市播州区枫香镇苟坝一带，马鬃岭山脚；马鬃岭另有金沙县、仁怀两说）佯动，引敌向北，掩护主力于 3 月 31 日由江口、大塘渡过乌江。主力渡江后，九军团按令南渡，4 月 2 日晨赶至乌江以北沙土地区，因国民党军 4 个师从西北、西南迫近，放弃渡江向北转移。4 月 4 日转移至老木孔、菜籽坳一带，5 日拂晓设伏，击溃尾追的黔军犹国才部 5 个团，毙伤 300 余人、俘 1800 余人，缴枪 1000 余支。此后 4 月 8 日智取瓢儿井盐场并休整三日，经毕节、纳雍、水城于 4 月下旬渡过北盘江进入云南，4 月 27 日至 29 日进占宣威，5 月 2 日至 3 日攻克会泽，5 月 4 日西进树桔渡。路线为示意，长干山、枫香坝取枫香镇代表点，逐日行程未全部画出。
description.en: On 21–22 March 1935 the Ninth Army Corps crossed the Chishui with the main force at the Taipingdu and Erlangtan ferries. From 24 March (other accounts say 27 or 30 March) it masqueraded as the Red Army main force, feinting around Changqianshan and Fengxiangba (the Gouba area of Fengxiang town, present-day Bozhou district, at the foot of Mazongling; other accounts place Mazongling in Jinsha or Renhuai county) to draw the enemy north while the main force crossed the Wu River at Jiangkou and Datang on 31 March. Ordered south after the crossing, the corps reached the Shatu area north of the river only on the morning of 2 April; with four Nationalist divisions closing from the northwest and southwest it gave up the crossing and turned north. On 4 April it reached Laomukong and Caiziao, and at dawn on the 5th it ambushed the pursuing 25th Army of Guizhou under You Guocai, routing five regiments, killing and wounding over 300, capturing more than 1,800 and taking over 1,000 rifles. It then took the Piaoerjing salt works on 8 April and rested three days, moved through Bijie, Nayong and Shuicheng, crossed the Beipan into Yunnan in late April, occupied Xuanwei on 27–29 April, took Huize on 2–3 May, and moved west to Shuju Ferry on 4 May. The line is schematic; Changqianshan and Fengxiangba use the Fengxiang town point, and the daily marches are not fully drawn.

name.zh: 北盘江—兴仁—兴义—富源—曲靖—寻甸—柯渡—皎平渡（中央纵队）

description.zh: 中央红军 4 月 16 日至 18 日分左右两路纵队抢渡北盘江：右路（红三军团、红五军团）由镇宁经坝草、白层渡江，左路（红一军团、军委纵队）由紫云经者坪渡江。渡江后经兴仁、安龙、兴义进入云南，连下平彝（今富源）、曲靖。4 月 29 日鲁口哨渡江令后，军委纵队与红五军团为中央纵队，经寻甸、柯渡北上，5 月 3 日抢占皎平渡，随后由此渡过金沙江。同期一军团为左纵队经马龙、嵩明、禄劝奔龙街渡，三军团为右纵队经沾益、寻甸奔洪门渡，两翼分进路线另见「马龙—嵩明—禄劝」「沾益—寻甸—禄劝—马鹿塘—洪门渡」两段。路线为示意，4 月 23 日至 28 日各路纵队并行西进，未再分线画出。
description.en: From 16 to 18 April 1935 the Central Red Army crossed the Beipan in two columns: the right column (Third and Fifth Army Corps) via Zhenning, Bacao and Baiceng, and the left column (First Army Corps and the Military Commission column) via Zheyang from Ziyun. After crossing, it moved through Xingren, Anlong and Xingyi into Yunnan and took Pingyi (present-day Fuyuan) and Qujing. After the Lukoushao crossing order of 29 April, the Military Commission column and the Fifth Army Corps formed the central column, moved north via Xundian and Kedu, and seized Jiaopingdu on 3 May, crossing the Jinsha there. The First Army Corps meanwhile formed the left column via Malong, Songming and Luquan toward Longjie, and the Third Army Corps the right column via Zhanyi and Xundian toward Hongmen; the two flanking tracks are drawn separately. The line is schematic; the parallel westward march of 23–28 April is not split into separate lines.

name.zh: 禄劝—武定—元谋（红一军团先头智取三城）
name.en: Luquan–Wuding–Yuanmou (1st Army Corps advance guard’s three-town ruse)

description.zh: 红一军团先头红二师第四团以三个连化装成国民党「中央军」，5 月 1 日入禄劝、5 月 2 日入武定并占元谋，随后由元谋西出 30 公里至龙街渡（接 order 20）。路线为示意，实际行军另有小路。
description.en: Three companies of the 4th Regiment, 2nd Division, disguised as KMT “Central Army” entered Luquan on 1 May and Wuding on 2 May, then took Yuanmou and pushed 30 km west to Longjie Ferry (linking with order 20). The line is schematic; the actual march used other tracks.

name.zh: 泸定—化林坪—飞越岭—汉源—荥经—天全—芦山—宝兴—硗碛—夹金山

description.zh: 中央红军 5 月 30 日由泸定东进化林坪，31 日夺取飞越岭，经汉源、荥经于 6 月 7 日占领天全、8 日突破芦山宝兴防线，11 日进抵夹金山下的硗碛，12 日先头部队由硗碛翻越夹金山，与红四方面军一部在达维会合。路线为示意，汉源一段走宜东、九襄方向，具体逐日行程未全部画出。
description.en: From Luding the Central Red Army moved east to Hualinping on 30 May, took Feiyueling on 31 May, passed through Hanyuan and Yingjing, took Tianquan on 7 June, broke the Lushan–Baoxing line on 8 June, reached Qiaoqi below Mount Jiajin on 11 June, and on 12 June its advance guard crossed Mount Jiajin and joined a Fourth Front Army detachment at Dawei. The line is schematic: the Hanyuan leg runs by Yidong and Jiuxiang, and the daily marches are not fully drawn.

name.zh: 夹金山—达维—懋功

description.zh: 中央红军先头部队 6 月 12 日翻越夹金山后进至达维，与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团会师；6 月 17 日中央机关到达达维，6 月 18 日主力进抵懋功（今小金）与红四方面军主力会师。路线为示意，达维至懋功一段沿山间大道，具体行程未逐日画出。
description.en: After crossing Mount Jiajin on 12 June the Central Red Army’s advance guard reached Dawei and joined the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army; the central organs reached Dawei on 17 June, and on 18 June the main force entered Maogong (present-day Xiaojin) and met the main force of the Fourth Front Army. The line is schematic: the Dawei–Maogong leg follows the mountain road, and the daily marches are not drawn.

name.zh: 延川—石楼—关上村—兑九峪—延川（东征）

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月 20 日，红一方面军以中国人民红军抗日先锋军名义东渡黄河，进入山西石楼、隰县一带，在关上村、兑九峪等地作战，5 月 5 日回师河西。路线为示意，与红十五军团东征路线同走廊，往返走同一条线。
description.en: On 20 February 1936 the First Front Army crossed the Yellow River eastward as the Chinese People’s Red Army Anti-Japanese Vanguard, entered the Shilou and Xixian area of Shanxi, fought at Guanshang and Duijiuyu, and returned west of the river on 5 May. The line is schematic, shares the corridor with the 15th Army Corps’ eastern expedition, and runs the same line out and back.

name.zh: 延川—盐池—豫旺堡—同心—界石铺—青江驿—会宁（西征与南下接应）

description.zh: 1936 年 5 月 18 日中革军委决定以红一方面军主力组成西方野战军西征，5 月 19 日出动，经环县、曲子进占盐池、豫旺堡、同心城一带；9 月底至 10 月初南下接应红二、红四方面军，经界石铺、青江驿进至会宁，10 月 9 日实现会宁会师。路线为示意，与红十五军团西征路线同走廊。
description.en: On 18 May 1936 the Revolutionary Military Council formed the Western Field Army from the main force of the First Front Army for a westward expedition; it set out on 19 May, moved through Huanxian and Quzi to take Yanchi, Yuwangpu and Tongxin, then turned south in late September and early October to receive the Second and Fourth Front Armies, reaching Huining via Jieshipu and Qingjiangyi, where the Huining link-up took place on 9 October. The line is schematic and shares the corridor with the 15th Army Corps’ western expedition.

name.zh: 马龙—嵩明—禄劝（左纵队·红一军团）

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 27 日红一军团由曲靖西进占领马龙，29 日攻克嵩明并前伸至昆明近郊，5 月 1 日先头进占禄劝。鲁口哨渡江令规定一军团（缺一个师）为左纵队，经嵩明、禄劝奔龙街渡。此后由禄劝经武定、元谋至龙街渡的段落另见「禄劝—武定—元谋（红一军团先头智取三城）」与「龙街渡佯渡（元谋—龙街渡）」两段。路线为示意。
description.en: On 27 April 1935 the First Army Corps moved west from Qujing to take Malong, on 29 April seized Songming and pushed to the outskirts of Kunming, and on 1 May its advance guard entered Luquan. The Lukoushao order made the First Army Corps (less one division) the left column, moving via Songming and Luquan toward Longjie. The continuation from Luquan via Wuding and Yuanmou to Longjie is drawn as the “Luquan–Wuding–Yuanmou” and “Yuanmou–Longjie” segments. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 长顺—江龙—坝草—白层—贞丰（右路纵队·红三军团抢渡北盘江）
name.en: Changshun–Jianglong–Bacao–Baiceng–Zhenfeng (right column, Third Army Corps crossing the Beipan)

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 9 日中央红军穿过贵阳、龙里间狭窄通道后，经惠水、长顺西进，4 月 13 日分左右两路纵队：三军团、五军团为右路，任务是由白层附近渡江、进占贞丰与兴仁。右路先遣团三军团第十一团 4 月 15 日凌晨从镇宁江龙出发，急行军 180 里，16 日上午到达北盘江东岸坝草渡口，在布依族老人王凤昌带引下由花滩浅水区涉渡，抢占贞丰坡扪制高点，架起坝草至坡扪浮桥；随后一营沿江东岸直下白层渡口，17 日凌晨守军保商营让出渡口，中午架起白层浮桥。坝草至坡扪、白层两座浮桥与下游者坪至弄洋浮桥一起，保障中央红军主力渡过北盘江。路线为示意，长顺、江龙、坝草取 OSM 点位，坡扪、弄洋不单独立点。
description.en: After passing through the narrow gap between Guiyang and Longli on 9 April 1935, the Central Red Army moved west through Huishui and Changshun and on 13 April split into two columns: the Third and Fifth Army Corps formed the right column, tasked with crossing near Baiceng and taking Zhenfeng and Xingren. The right column’s advance regiment, the 11th Regiment of the Third Army Corps, set out from Jianglong in Zhenning before dawn on 15 April, marched 180 li, and reached Bacao Ferry on the east bank of the Beipan on the morning of the 16th. Guided by the Bouyei elder Wang Fengchang, it forded at the shallows of Huatan, seized the height at Pomen in Zhenfeng, and built the Bacao–Pomen pontoon bridge; a battalion then moved downstream along the east bank to Baiceng, where the defending merchant-protection battalion gave up the ferry before dawn on the 17th and the Baiceng bridge was built that noon. Together with the Zheyang–Nongyang bridge downstream, the three pontoon bridges carried the main force across the Beipan. The line is schematic; Changshun, Jianglong and Bacao use OSM points, and Pomen and Nongyang are not plotted separately.

name.zh: 紫云—册亨—安龙—兴仁（左路纵队·红一军团与军委纵队抢渡北盘江）
name.en: Ziyun–Ceheng–Anlong–Xingren (left column, First Army Corps and Military Commission column crossing the Beipan)

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 13 日中革军委电令：一军团及军委纵队为左路纵队，任务是在罗炎附近渡江，经册亨进占安龙。红一军团第一师第二团在占领长顺后于 4 月 15 日受命为左路先遣团，当日进占紫云，16 日经观文、羊架等战斗继续西进，18 日中午到达北盘江下游者坪渡口，当日黄昏架成者坪至弄洋浮桥。此后经册亨进占安龙，与右路纵队在兴仁一带会合。路线为示意，者坪、弄洋未单独立点，紫云至册亨一段跨北盘江处即者坪渡口附近。
description.en: The Revolutionary Military Council order of 13 April 1935 made the First Army Corps and the Military Commission column the left column, to cross near Luoyan and move through Ceheng to take Anlong. The 2nd Regiment of the 1st Division was ordered on 15 April, after taking Changshun, to lead the left column; it took Ziyun that day, fought through Guanwen and Yangjia on the 16th, reached Zheyang Ferry downstream on the Beipan at noon on the 18th, and completed the Zheyang–Nongyang pontoon bridge that dusk. It then moved through Ceheng to Anlong and joined the right column around Xingren. The line is schematic; Zheyang and Nongyang are not plotted separately, and the Ziyun–Ceheng leg crosses the Beipan near Zheyang Ferry.

name.zh: 大树堡—晒经关—河南站—安顺场（红五团撤离返回）

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 26 日，在大树堡担任吸引钳制任务的红军第一军团第二师第五团接到军团电令，火速撤离大树堡到安顺场与主力会合。为避免沿大渡河南岸行军被北岸敌军发现，五团重返晒经关，经河南站、平坝、窑厂，翻竹马垭口到安顺场。红军突然撤离使北岸川军一时不明所以。路线为示意，晒经关取既有佯动路线顶点，河南站取河南乡点，平坝、窑厂、竹马垭口未单独立点。
description.en: On 26 May 1935 the Fifth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, which had been pinning the enemy at Dashubao, received a corps order to withdraw swiftly to Anshunchang and rejoin the main force. To avoid being spotted from the north bank while marching along the south bank of the Dadu, it returned via Shaijing Pass, Henan station, Pingba and Yaochang, crossed the Zhuma pass, and reached Anshunchang; the sudden withdrawal left the Sichuan troops on the north bank baffled. The line is schematic; Shaijing uses the existing feint-route vertex, Henan uses the Henan township point, and Pingba, Yaochang and the Zhuma pass are not plotted separately.
